newsitem.title: FRANCE: PRESS DIGEST - France - Le Monde Sept 30.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - France - Le Monde Sept 30.

text.p: These are leading stories in afternoon daily Le Monde.

-- Government hopes to create 300,000 jobs in the next five years by turning minimal welfare benefits into administrative jobs in the welfare sector, calls for local solidarity action from firms towards young jobless.
-- Workers at SNCF rail operator strike today for improved working conditions, school teachers strike against planned job cuts.
-- British Telecom's plan to ally with Cie Generale des Eaux in French telecommunications, which will be deregulated in 1998, marks a push for second place on the French market after France Telecom.
-- Trading of shares in Eurotunnel channel tunnel operator suspended today pending statement on debt-restructuring.
-- Buying power of French white-collar workers expected to stagnate in 1996 as taxes and contributions offset wage rises, study shows.
